summary: Eldorado Gold filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated September 28, 2026, announcing completion of permanent grid energization at its Skouries mine in northern Greece following final inspection, testing and approval by the Greek transmission authority. The disclosure is an operational milestone, not a special situation. CEO George Burns noted the connection supports commissioning and ramp-up toward commercial production expected in Q4 2026; Skouries is projected to average 140,000 ounces of gold and 67 million pounds of copper annually. No deal terms, board recommendation or advisors are stated.
